verdict.rationale: Reclaim ships its own event-driven automations: auto-rescheduling when a meeting overbooks a lower-priority event, auto-adding travel time to events with a location and decompression time after meetings, Slack status sync from event categories, and auto-locking Smart Meetings at 4am. Users can also tag events with hashtags (#reclaim_free, #reclaim_busy, #needs_travel, #nosync, #focus) to trigger specific scheduler behaviors. However, these are preset behaviors with toggles, not a user-defined rule engine with arbitrary triggers and actions. missing for 10: a general custom rule/trigger-action builder, user-defined event conditions beyond fixed hashtags and settings, and independent corroboration of rule-style automation.
